blocking.heading: When you write a sentence

blocking.problem: In skills/writing/agent-instructions/references/agent-skills-spec.md, line 50, "its" and "it" can each refer to the text of the user or to the description, so the reader cannot know which item to keep and which item to write.

advisory.heading: When you select the words and the tone
advisory.text: Select the Skills folder of the project first
advisory.problem: In agent-skills-spec.md line 11, this rule tells the agent to select the Skills folder of the project for each Skill, but the referenced section at line 73 gives a rule for that folder only "When the target platforms include Claude Code and Codex", so for other target platforms (for example Claude Code only, with only `.agents/skills/` in the project) the section gives no rule, and the agent can select a folder that a target platform does not load.
advisory.correction: At line 73, add a rule for all target platforms before the Claude Code and Codex rule: "Tier 1: Use a folder from the table that each target platform loads. When the target platforms include Claude Code and Codex, use the Skills folder of the project."

advisory.heading: When you put the text in sections and lists
advisory.text: Tier 1: When the target platforms include Claude Code and Codex, use the Skills folder of the project.
advisory.problem: In agent-skills-spec.md line 73, one paragraph mixes facts with 4 rules (find the target platforms, use the Skills folder of the project, ask the user, add a warning), while each other section of the file gives its rules as bullets with a tier at the start.
advisory.correction: Keep the facts in the paragraph and put each rule in a bullet, for example: "- Before you select the folder, find the target platforms as `loading-rules.md` tells you." "- Tier 1: When the target platforms include Claude Code and Codex, use the Skills folder of the project. (advisory)" "- Tier 1: If the project has 2 or more of these folders, or none of these folders, ask the user one time which folder to use. (advisory)" "- Tier 1: For each Skill that you write for these target platforms, add a warning that gives the platform that does not load the Skill. (advisory)"
